stemMd: What did observations show after labels were shortened?

options.label: A
options.textMd: All visitors read every label completely.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The museum removed all written information.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Visitors spent less time at displays but talked about objects more often.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Visitors spent more time at every individual display.

explanationMd: The first paragraph reports two different changes: shorter dwell time and more discussion. Those measures point to different aspects of engagement. Neither alone supplies a complete evaluation.

distractorRationale.a: The text does not establish completion for everyone.
distractorRationale.b: Labels were shortened rather than abolished.
